title: The established preparation architecture receives a qualified counting contract
statement: The Grover–Rudolph and Vuong Theorem 33 pinned-purification architecture receives this acquired-class pinning closure and sharp precision; it is established architecture, not an invention of quantum state preparation. For m=2n, output trace error <=||R_M||+sqrt(2n)eta+4n tau+2zeta. One allocation is ||R_M||<=epsilon/4, eta=epsilon/(4sqrt(2n)), tau=epsilon/(16n), zeta=epsilon/8. A fixed independent tape is reused coherently; pointwise failure delta_q<=zeta/(2^(2n+1)-2) plus union bound earns simultaneous goodness without enumerating prefixes. Median amplification costs O(n+log(1/epsilon)); direct Chebyshev substitution would be exponential. BOTH statistical and numerical errors fit each delta_q. Cost is C_acq+O(n T_pin(I,M,epsilon/(4sqrt(2n)),epsilon/[8(2^(2n+1)-2)])) plus reversible arithmetic/rotations. Physical mesh is chosen for operator error; finer counting uses more quadrature/sampling/arithmetic on that mesh. High-precision pinned counter, broader native implementation and quantum circuit were not executed. No generic speedup follows.

requires: Acquired J=D0+S+AA^T, S PSD with norm<=kappa, B=AA^T of controlled rank r and norm<=Lambda, actual beta/fields/rates/mesh M, susceptibility chi_M and first omitted collective frequency Omega. Strict alpha=kappa chi_M+4 Lambda/Omega<1, uniformly in every longitudinal field.

Exact or budgeted positive one-spin cyclic transfer evaluation and sampling, independent uniform-word and arithmetic contract, exact support/zero handling. Whole spin paths are conditionally independent only after Gaussian conditioning.

Thermal preparation requires compatible pins, potential-outside symmetric product, a genuine fixed random tape simultaneously good for all coherent prefixes, amplified statistical AND numerical precision, reversible counting and actual gates.

Raw page/UI/sidebar capture is private. Actual public Gaussian and Alternatives shared-context reviews are carried only at their stated scopes, not blind independence or a whole-architecture audit. Known Gaussian augmentation and pinned thermal-preparation architecture retain their primary ancestry. The completed 12-spin full high-frequency run is separate from the preceding 64-spin two-bin computation. Conditional confidence requires independent uniform words and the exact arithmetic contract; seeded pseudorandom reproducibility is not a proof of independence. Full spectral comparison wins. General high-precision pinned counter, broader native implementation and reversible quantum circuit remain unbuilt; no generic speedup, device or practical advantage.
costs: Dense sweep costs O(n(q+r)M+rM log M), q=rank S; mesh-independent sweep contraction is not mesh-independent arithmetic. All spatial factors, Gaussian coordinates, temporal transforms, transfers, retained quadrature nodes and actual finite-bit work remain paid.

Acquisition is reused, pinned normalizers are separate full computations. Fixed temperature, physical bounds, retained dimension and positive contraction margin are needed for polynomial asymptotics; cooling can enlarge the difficult sector.

Completed main run: 33,200 trajectories, 16,965,200 sweeps, 6,527,385,600 binary spin-time draws, 7,057,523,200 Gaussian scalars, 13,584,908,800 uniform52 words, 450.551966 s on two CPU threads. Full ledger includes failed/preliminary work and unknown early timings.
